did: Made home's take library (GET /voice-notes/takes) answer every kind of voice note in one shape: an exhaustive per-kind about (game name, bite and matched play; interview rung; studio project/shot or idea), status with receipts, kind/date/about/text filters, sort, cursor paging, read-only and additive for today's phone, with contract epoch 19. Privacy invariant 23 was amended on the owner's word.

calls.title: C605: widen the existing take route additively, opt-in by kind
options: widen /takes additively, opt-in by kind, receipts only when a kind is asked, epoch raised
calls.why: Today's phone and the contract harness drop unknown fields but need ref as a string and read every take as Studio's.
calls.undo: Drop the kind branch of voice_repo::takes::Ask and the added fields; nothing is stored.

calls.title: C606: page by an opaque cursor
calls.why: A bare id 422s when the page's last take is deleted or no longer found; an offset shifts as takes arrive.
calls.undo: Replace after/next in takes::Ask and Library; nothing is stored.

calls.title: C607: one about key per take, nested game detail
options: one key, nested bite and match
calls.why: The owner named examples but no key grammar; one key keeps the filter a single equality.

calls.title: C608: meaning index stays Studio-only
options: Studio-only with an honest by: words fallback
calls.why: Widening the index widens invariant 35 and the catch-up; text search is what TAKES20 asks for.
calls.undo: Widen voice_repo::meaning later; the library needs no change.

calls.title: C609 (owner): amend privacy invariant 23
options: (a) every kind, with the bite's fields
calls.why: The owner, 2026-11-18: "go with a for rule 23".
calls.undo: Revert the invariant sentence and the kind branch; nothing is stored.

left: The phone half must pass next back as after unchanged, URL-encoded.
Search by meaning covers Studio takes only; widening voice_repo::meaning to every kind would make a mixed read rank by meaning.
Bites deleted for good are listed under ?kind=game but not under their game's about key, because a receipt keeps no ref.
Rust Deny Checks (advisories) is red on main for chrono/chrono-tz (#953), not this PR.
